about: Matched research tasks for the impact comparison, written 2026-11-15 before any run and hash-locked in eval/IMPACT.lock. 'reference' lists the curated findings a complete answer must cite; each finding maps to a page of an original NASA publication. 'keywords' is what a researcher would type into a full-text search of the same 14 publications (the traditional-search proxy). The automated comparison is a PROXY: it measures machine retrieval of the reference pages, not human time.

tasks.task: Find every NASA finding on Nomex burning in microgravity.
Is there documented evidence of PMMA and Nomex burning as a combined sample, and of polyester with polyurethane foam?
Which findings apply to cotton-fiberglass fabric in microgravity at about 21% O2 and 20 cm/s flow, and which of them carry a source conflict?
Of PMMA, cotton-fiberglass (SIBAL), Nomex, silicone, methanol and Kapton, which have no direct experimental finding at partial (lunar or Martian) gravity?
Prepare a cited evidence summary of the Orbital Research Module at its cabin conditions, including gaps and limitations.
